notes.title: Update in December 28th
notes.content:
The following improvements were made through the update on December 28th.

-Universalizing difficulty of some levels.
-Corrected possible design errors for some levels.
-Fixed a problem where certain obstacles did not work at low frequency.
-Modified the UI to prevent it from encroaching outside the screen.
-A description of the playing has been added to the tutorial level.
-Modified the Sprite of some collection elements.
-Modified the Sprite of some interaction objects.
-Some visual effects derived from characters have been modified.
